summary: G304: the 4 POLLEN pre-loads are specifically allocated to each team per 10.3.1; other POLLEN a ROBOT touches at setup don't count toward its pre-load. G412: subsequent violations are now DISABLED and YELLOW CARD per MATCH. G419: examples F and G reworded; disconnecting a battery or powering off a ROBOT is an example of a ROBOT no longer able to drive, instead of automatically a RED CARD.
